text:
leah.sales: Procurement from CuraLife wants a minimal evidence packet to sign PO: SOC2 excerpts, ISO scope note, signed pen-test attestation, redacted staging diagram, and KMS separation statement. Also: does Dedicated + customer KMS change pricing? Need a short paragraph reply.
omar.sec: We can deliver a redacted SOC2 control excerpt and ISO scope note. Pen-test: one-page attestation signed by security lead only. We do not share full reports or internal logs.
vik.devops: For scanning we can provide ephemeral staging creds and a presigned upload path (7-day TTL). On-prem access requires SOW and legal/ops approval. Presign naming: `curalife_evidence/<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf`.
nate.eng: I'll produce a redacted network sketch and a one-page KMS separation note pulled from our ops playbook. Need ~48 hours to sanitize and redact internal details.
leah.sales: Pricing blurb for procurement?
omar.sec: Short: Dedicated capacity plus customer-managed KMS is treated as Enterprise tier (platform fee) and Dedicated commitment; expect a one-time integration effort for KMS. Mark pricing as provisional pending RevOps.
vik.devops: Ops impact: add ~3 business days for KMS integration and smoke tests when provisioning Dedicated. If they want a formal SOW, we will draft one.
legal-bot: pen-test-attestation-template.pdf available: https://redwood.internal/evidence/pen-test-attestation-template.pdf (uploader: legal-bot).
leah.sales: Draft paragraph to send: "We can provide a compact evidence packet (redacted SOC2 excerpt, ISO scope note, signed pen-test attestation, redacted staging diagram, and KMS separation statement) within ~3 business days. Pen-test attestation signature may take up to 7 business days for legal sign-off. Enabling Dedicated with customer-managed KMS typically requires Enterprise-tier licensing (platform fee), a Dedicated commitment, and a one-time integration charge; exact pricing will be confirmed by RevOps. For scanning access we can issue ephemeral staging credentials and a presigned upload link (7-day TTL). We do not provide full penetration test reports or raw internal logs." 
omar.sec: LGTM. Ping security if they request full reports; we'll decline and offer remediation summary/POA.
vik.devops: Creating presigned path now and will post masked creds when ready.
nate.eng: Will upload redacted diagram to presigned bucket and tag this thread when done (ETA 48h).
leah.sales: Thanks team  sending to procurement and flagging pricing as provisional.
